info.name: AttendTrack API
info.description:
Run the folders top to bottom (or use the Collection Runner). Seed the DB first: `npm run seed` in /server.
Variables (adminToken, teacherToken, studentToken, courseId, ...) are filled in automatically by test scripts.

request.description: Email is generated when the collection is exported; change it if you re-run and get 409.
Reuse of a rotated token is rejected and all sessions of that user are revoked.
